test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All beds are sofa sets.

Some sofa sets are mattresses.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some sofa set are beds.

II. Some mattresses are sofa sets.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
**Least Possible Venn Diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8de218e778ec9cc6ef1d9dbb693d28bd15eaf901e7dade38effe37cbffbdbec.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sofa set are beds → **Follows** (All bed are sofa sets than some sofa sets are bed.Hence, it is definitely true)

II. Some mattresses are sofa sets → **Follows **(Some mattresses are sofa set than some sofa will be mattress. Hence, it is definitely true)

Hence,** "both conclusion I and II follows".**
